## Checklist

- [ ] Follows the rules in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) (lab material only, no real credentials/data)
- [ ] Every PoC change ships with documentation in `docs/` (technique, prerequisites, expected behavior)
- [ ] No obfuscation, anti-analysis, or AV/EDR evasion added
- [ ] No binaries, dumps, keys, or other sensitive artifacts committed (`.gitignore` respected)
- [ ] Techniques mapped to MITRE ATT&CK (technique + sub-technique)
- [ ] Notes written in English and consistent within each file
- [ ] Lab experiment result included in the PR description (for new PoCs)
